Skyline Airways

You're flying with Skyline Airways today. Walk up to the check-in desk, choose your flight, check your bags, pick a seat, and get through the security questions. Once you have your boarding pass, head into the terminal — just listen carefully, because gates can change at any moment.

今日はSkyline Airwaysで出発します。チェックインカウンターで便を選び、荷物を預け、座席を選び、セキュリティの質問に答えましょう。搭乗券を受け取ったらターミナルへ進みます。搭乗口が変更されることもあるので、アナウンスをよく聞いてください。

At the check-in desk · チェックインカウンター

  • Hi, I'd like to check in for my flight to ___, please.
  • Could I check this bag, please?
  • Could I have a window seat, please?
  • Is there an extra charge for that?

Answering security questions · セキュリティ質問

  • Yes, I packed it myself.
  • No, everything in my bag is mine.
  • All my liquids are under 100ml.
  • I don't have anything sharp in my carry-on.

Listening for announcements · アナウンス

  • Excuse me, did they just say our gate?
  • I think our gate has changed.
  • What gate are we at now?
  • We'd better hurry — that was the final call.
